paragraphs: In the introduction to the Zohar, Bereshit 10a, he is described as a philosopher who converted in Kfar Shachlim and became a great Torah scholar.[^1]

notes.text: י. gives the Zohar introduction 10a under the period convention, without independent named-edition verification. ואיגייר is finite converted, not the noun a-convert; ת״ח is Torah scholar. The conversion, Kfar Shachlim and became-great-scholar sequence remain source claims. The supplied terminal comma is normalized as an English period, without claiming that substantive words are missing; provisional heading/extent status remains unresolved. No title is added from scholar status.
